CLOSING AS SUPERSEDED (operator-directed close-out, 2026-08-09).

This story's work was folded into bug b636, which LANDED as commit 5e7d6e71ba (verified ancestor of origin/main). The implementation lives in src/rebar/_commands/fsck_repair.py rather than the planned compact_rebuild.py:

- restore_deleted_sources (:662) — writes deleted pre-images back as .retired, never live.
- _deleted_history (:626) — one 'git log --diff-filter=D --name-only -- <tid>/' pass with an explicit newest-deletion-wins setdefault fold, whose docstring records the oldest-wins contrast with build_ticket_position_commit_map.
- rebuild_with_restore (:714) — composes restore with rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log.
- _dry_run_plan (:609) — writes nothing.

Held-out tests exist for both the recovery and the newest-pre-image tie-break, and the refusal test is unchanged.

RESIDUAL GAP, filed as follow-up 08c8-b6b2-4da6-4373 (linked discovered_from): _repair_ticket (:208) still calls rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log DIRECTLY at :269-271 instead of routing through rebuild_with_restore, so that repair entry point never attempts a restore. It fails closed rather than corrupting anything.

No further work will be done under this id.
